acceptance.given: A Toolchain external-process invocation is configured with a finite output limit.

oracle.expected: The execution receipt records captured output at or below the configured finite limit and a bounded terminal state.
forbidden: Output capture is unbounded or exceeds the configured limit without deterministic failure.
oracle.observable: Process execution receipt and bounded-output check during runtime verification

acceptance.then: The external process output remains within its configured finite limit.
acceptance.when: During runtime execution of the Toolchain subprocess, inspect the process receipt and output-bound enforcement.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Select an external-process execution path whose configured output bound is absent or exceeded, and assert deterministic unsuccessful handling.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Enforce and verify a finite output capture limit for each external process, with deterministic unsuccessful handling when the limit is violated.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Preserve existing receipt schema and fail-closed terminal categories; rollback removes only the new bound enforcement.

slice_hint.state_transition: executing -> bounded-terminal (or deterministic unsuccessful on output-limit violation)
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: A runtime receipt proves output_bytes <= configured_output_limit and records a deterministic terminal category.

acceptance.given: A Toolchain external-process invocation is configured with a finite timeout.

oracle.expected: The execution receipt records termination or stopping at or before the configured timeout and a bounded terminal state.
forbidden: The process continues beyond the configured timeout without a deterministic terminal result.
oracle.observable: Process execution receipt and timeout enforcement check during runtime verification

acceptance.then: The external process terminates or is stopped within its configured finite time limit.
acceptance.when: During runtime execution of the Toolchain subprocess, inspect start/stop timestamps, timeout status, and terminal receipt.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Select an external-process execution path with a missing or exceeded timeout and assert deterministic timeout failure.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Enforce and verify a finite wall-clock timeout for each external process, stopping overdue processes and preserving deterministic unsuccessful terminal state.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Preserve existing receipt schema and timeout terminal semantics; rollback removes only the new timeout enforcement.

slice_hint.terminal_predicate: A runtime receipt proves elapsed_time <= configured_timeout or explicitly records timed-out with deterministic unsuccessful outcome.

acceptance.given: A fresh-checkout replay is prepared from pinned current inputs and the snapshot manifest schema.

oracle.expected: The Current Snapshot manifest contains immutable canonical identities for Git baseline, Skill-input selection/content, code, fixtures, contracts, Consumers, tests, targets, validators, dependencies, sources, evidence, and normalization policy.
forbidden: Any result-determining input is omitted, mutable-only, or represented solely by historical evidence.
oracle.observable: Snapshot manifest artifact and schema validation performed before fresh replay

acceptance.then: The snapshot manifest lists each result-determining input with its canonical immutable identity before replay.
acceptance.when: During integration verification, validate the typed Current Snapshot manifest before launching the fresh replay.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Select a snapshot manifest fixture with one result-determining input omitted or mutable and assert pre-replay validation failure.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Build and validate a complete immutable Current Snapshot manifest before replay, covering every result-determining input category.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Keep existing manifest version compatibility and reject incomplete manifests without mutating historical evidence.

slice_hint.state_transition: unpinned fresh checkout -> complete immutable Current Snapshot -> replay eligible
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: Pre-replay schema and coverage validation succeeds only when every result-determining input has an immutable canonical identity.

acceptance.given: Validator evaluation has a declared semantic-dependency closure definition and independently inspectable dependency inputs.

oracle.expected: Independent verification evidence enumerates the complete executable, data, policy, configuration, and environment closure and records a deterministic pass or failure for that closure.
forbidden: Closure verification is omitted, inferred solely from another verification, or reduced to Probe reachability.
oracle.observable: Independent closure-verification receipt and dependency enumeration during integration verification

acceptance.when: During validator evaluation, run the dedicated closure verification and inspect its own receipt independently of target, probe, or snapshot checks.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Select an evaluation fixture lacking an independent semantic-dependency closure receipt or omitting a closure category, and assert the validator gate fails.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Perform an independent fixed-point semantic-dependency closure verification across executable, data, policy, configuration, and environment inputs and bind its receipt to evaluation.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Preserve existing semantic repository context interfaces; rollback removes only closure-gate integration and leaves historical receipts intact.

slice_hint.terminal_predicate: A dedicated closure receipt enumerates all five dependency categories and is independently validated before semantic verdict acceptance.
